Class Weapon

java.lang.Object
main.item.Item
main.item.Weapon
public class Weapon extends Item
Represents a weapon item that can be equipped by characters. Weapons deal damage and can be either physical or magical.

      public Weapon(String name, double weight, double value, double damage, boolean isMagic)
      Creates a new weapon with default MEDIUM rarity.
      Parameters:
      name - The weapon's name

    • Weapon

      public Weapon(String name, double weight, double value, double damage, boolean isMagic, ItemRarity rarity)
      Creates a new weapon with specified rarity.
      Parameters:
      name - The weapon's name

      value - The weapon's monetary value

    • Weapon

      public Weapon(String name, double weight, double value, double damage, boolean isMagic, ItemRarity rarity, double specialDamage, String specialAttackName, String specialFlavorText, int ppCost, int ppGainPerUse)
      Creates a new weapon with all parameters including PP special attack data.
      Parameters:
      name - The weapon's name
      weight - The weapon's weight
      value - The weapon's monetary value
      damage - The base damage the weapon deals
      isMagic - Whether the weapon is magical (scales with intelligence instead of strength)
      rarity - The weapon's rarity level
      specialDamage - Additional damage dealt by special attack
      specialAttackName - Name of the special attack
      specialFlavorText - Flavor text displayed when special is used
      ppCost - Power Points required to use special attack
      ppGainPerUse - Power Points gained per normal attack with this weapon
